text.cn: 过山车队列像另一条早高峰。尖叫是门票附赠音效。有人边排队边吃鸡爪——快乐与奇葩并行不悖。
text.en: Coaster queues feel like morning rush. Screams are included audio. Someone eats chicken feet in line — joy and weirdness coexist.

text.cn: 狂坐过山车：肾上腺素临时覆盖焦虑。

feedback.cn: 你喊得很真诚。下来后头发像经历了台风，心情意外不错。
feedback.en: Your screams were sincere. Hair looks typhooned; mood oddly good.

text.cn: 选温和项目：保护颈椎与面子。
text.en: Mild rides: protect neck and dignity.

feedback.cn: 你没有变成表情包。有时这就是胜利。
feedback.en: You didn’t become a meme. Sometimes that’s the win.

text.cn: 排队三小时只坐一个：时间刺客体验卡。
text.en: Three-hour queue for one ride: time assassin DLC.

feedback.cn: 项目九十秒。排队半生。你开始重新评估「快乐」的单价。
feedback.en: Ride: 90 seconds. Queue: half a life. You reprice happiness per minute.

text.cn: 欢乐谷日结束。嗓子哑了，快乐账单已出。
text.en: Happy Valley ends. Throat hoarse; joy invoice issued.
